title: Ginga Ojousama Densetsu Yuna Remix
native_title: 銀河お嬢様伝説 ユナ リミックス
overview:
The year is 2299. Yuna Kagurazaka, a cheerful and absent-minded first-year at a private girls' school, wins the Galaxy Fraulein Contest and becomes Earth's representative and a pop idol overnight. Then a mysterious visitor appears in her bedroom with news of an ancient war between light and darkness. The darkness has kidnapped the other contestants, and Yuna, the Savior of Light, is its next target.

This digital comic adventure is a remake of the first Galaxy Fraulein Yuna game, with updated graphics and new animated scenes. Choose commands to explore and talk your way through the story, with some choices leading to side stories and minigames. Battles are one-on-one duels fought through the same commands: wear down your rival's HP, and spend Ojousama Points on mean-spirited attacks.

- 1 player
